description.en: Four curated ready-to-use theme suites plus an independent custom theme studio with offline HD wallpapers, built-in typography presets, WCAG-calibrated palettes, translucent surfaces, and local image/video/font import across Codex Desktop and CH Web.
description.zh-CN: 内置 4 套精选成品主题套装，并提供独立的自定义方案编辑器——自由导入本地壁纸/视频、调配色、选字体与调节五大界面通透度，支持 Codex Desktop 与 CH Web。

details.en:
### Highlights

- **Four Built-in Theme Suites**: One-click curated bundles (Default · Rainy Forest, Glacial Glass, Nordic Minimal, and Moonlit Sakurabridge) pairing offline 1080p wallpapers, harmonious accents, typography presets, transparent canvas/sidebar, and crisp zero-blur cards & composer.
- **Independent Custom Theme Studio**: Build up to 20 custom themes from scratch — directly import local images/videos, HTTPS image URLs, or animated backdrops; dial in colors via 2D color wheel, HSV/HEX/RGB, wallpaper extraction, or current color import; choose built-in typography or upload a local font; and tune all five surface opacities and frost blurs.
- **Unified Accent Palette & Native Chrome Sync**: Harmonizes buttons, sidebar navigation, tabs, borders, subtle glass surface tints, text selection, scrollbars, embedded Host settings, and Windows custom titlebar controls while keeping WCAG AA contrast and a luminous top-left CodexHost brand mark.
- **Five Independent Translucent Surfaces**: Fine-tune opacity (0–100%), frost blur (0–40 px), and text outline separately for Main Canvas, Sidebar (with subtle expanded parent-child thread cards), Cards & Menus, Composer (positioned lower in new-chat view to showcase your wallpaper), and Settings Panel.
- **Built-in Typography & Local Fonts**: Choose from 6 curated CJK/Latin typography presets (Modern Sans, Airy Clean, Editorial Serif, Literary Kai, Fine FangSong, Geometric Tech) or load a single WOFF2/WOFF/TTF/OTF font up to 50 MiB while keeping monospace code blocks, terminals, and icons intact.
- **Rich Backdrops & Day/Night Automation**: 4 offline bundled 1080p HD wallpapers, public HTTPS images, local JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF/AVIF (up to 20 MiB), silent looping MP4/WebM videos (up to 200 MiB), 30-image rotation pools, Mesh gradients, 4 WebGL shaders, 6 Canvas patterns, time/OS schedules, and JSON import/export.
- **Interactive Otter Composer Pet**: CodexHost's iconic otter perches playfully on the top-right corner of the chat composer with smooth breathing, curious tilting, typing rhythm, and click-to-hop sparkle reactions.

### Cross-Device Sync & Privacy

- Pure frontend Manifest v2 extension with **zero background processes** and no telemetry.
- Appearance settings, built-in preset references, schedules, and media UUID references sync via CodexHost Host storage; local binary files stay in IndexedDB per browser profile/partition and can be relinked cleanly across Desktop, Chrome, and WebView2.
details.zh-CN:
### 核心特性

- **4 套开箱即用的内置成品方案**：精选「默认 · 雨林森屿」「冰湖琉璃」「云岚雅白」「月夜樱桥」4 套离线成品套装，一键应用 1080p 高清壁纸、协调强调色、专属排版字体、低透明主界面/侧栏与 0 磨砂清爽卡片和输入区。
- **独立的自定义方案编辑器**：从零创建、编辑并保存最多 20 套个人方案（支持一键保存当前配色与外观）——在弹窗内直接导入本地图片/视频、网络图片或动态背景，使用 2D 色轮 / HSV / HEX / RGB、壁纸提色或导入当前配色自由调色，选用内置字体或上传本端字体，并独立微调五大界面区域的透明度与磨砂。
- **全局主题配色与窗口控件同步**：主题色统一谐和按钮、左侧功能栏、标签页、边框、轻盈通透表面、文本选区、滚动条、内嵌设置弹窗以及 Windows 顶栏原生最小化/最大化/关闭按钮对比度，同时守住 WCAG AA 规范并保持左上角 CodexHost 品牌标志清晰醒亮。
- **五大界面区域独立调节**：分别控制主界面、侧栏（含展开父子对话轻分组卡片）、卡片与菜单、输入区（新建对话卡片自动下移让出壁纸主视觉）和设置面板的不透明度（0–100%）、磨砂模糊（0–40 px）与文字描边。
- **内置排版风格与本端字体**：内置 6 套中英协调排版预设（现代黑体、轻盈等线、人文宋体、书卷楷体、清雅仿宋、科技几何），亦支持上传单字体 WOFF2 / WOFF / TTF / OTF（上限 50 MiB），代码块、终端与图标保持等宽原样。
- **多源静/动态背景与昼夜定时**：支持 4 张离线内置高清壁纸、公开 HTTPS 图片、本地图片（上限 20 MiB）、静音循环 MP4/WebM 视频（上限 200 MiB）、30 图轮换池、网格渐变、4 种着色器与 6 种几何图案，支持昼夜自动切换及 JSON 导入导出。
- **聊天框右上角水獭宠物挂件**：将 CodexHost 标志性小水獭作为灵动宠物挂件栖息在聊天输入框右上角，日常自然呼吸歪头，打字时欢快轻律动，点击还会开心蹦跳并冒出星光。

### 跨端同步与隐私

- 纯前端 Manifest v2 架构，**零后台常驻进程**、零外部遥测。
- 外观参数、内置方案引用、定时计划与媒体 UUID 引用通过 Host 跨端共享；本地上传文件保存在各端浏览器 IndexedDB 中，可在 Desktop、Chrome 与 WebView2 间复用 UUID 无损重关联。
